Title: Application Insights is Generally Available in China East 2

Body.Content:
Azure Application Insights is now generally available in China East 2 Region.

You can see the full list of available regions on the product web page.

Azure Application Insights is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Sending data to Application Insights in the China regions requires alternate endpoints from public Azure. See this document for more information:

Global Service monitoring is available using endpoints from outside the Azure China Cloud, via a public subscription.

Learn more about Azure Monitor and Application Insights in the documentation.
